items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: From Al Jays. They called his brother Bebe, Bill Mathias.

ctx.x: Well, all them bands, like Imperial Band, you know.
Yeah. Yeah. Now, you got a fella playing trombone. His brother was a drummer too. From Al Jays. They called his brother Bebe, Bill Mathias. Oh, yeah.
He had a brother play drums, Bebe.
